instructions: Reconstruct the standing desk from the original Sample (2) room photograph and its measured 66 x 30 x 30 inch envelope. Author independent manufactured components in Blender: a thin radiused smoked-glass panel and edge, two nested lift columns, broad T-feet with levelers, mounting flanges, satin fasteners, cross-support rails, an open cable pan, and a lift controller. Apply small true bevels, UV coordinates, subtle exported albedo/roughness textures, separate PBR material slots, and a candidate-local reflection probe. Preserve the RoomDefinition-owned placement, footprint, DESK_TOP anchor, and separate monitors/equipment. Inspect actual RoomScale captures and fail on any unclear joins, hardware, surface defects, insufficient photo-character, or gameplay/performance regression.

parameters.glass_albedo_roughness: 1024x1024; dark neutral albedo; roughness 0.11 with very subtle variation
parameters.graphite_albedo_roughness: 1024x1024; restrained graphite with low-contrast directional finish; roughness 0.29

tool: Blender Python/bpy source-measured assembly generator and RoomScale Godot Art Factory
tool_version: Blender 5.2.3; bpy; Pillow; NumPy; Godot 4.7.2 official
material_method: Principled metallic-roughness PBR with packed smoked-glass and graphite albedo/roughness images, satin steel hardware, dielectric rubber, and a candidate-local Godot reflection probe
post_processing: Deterministic source-measured component geometry with independent radiused parts and manufacturing seams
UV smart projection with baked subtle albedo and roughness maps
GLB export with packed materials, plus Godot PackedScene wrapper and candidate-local reflection probe
Godot technical bounds validation and canonical RoomScale production renders
Visual inspection against the original photograph and current desk-v007 incumbent

import_configuration.format: Godot PackedScene wrapper with Blender-exported GLB child
import_configuration.probe: UPDATE_ONCE candidate-local ReflectionProbe, candidate excluded from capture
